title: Per-Contract Capacity Phasing — Sep 2026
content:
Purpose:
This working sheet slices per-contract GPU reservations into a month-by-month allocation plan for Dedicated customers (Q4 2026 runway). Goal: ensure contractual entitlements are mapped to regional capacity, expose ramp risk, and capture actions to avoid SLA breaches. This is an iteration — please update usage numbers weekly.

High-level summary:
- Planning horizon: 2026-09 to 2027-02 (6 months).
- Primary constraints: H100 availability in us-west1 and eu-west1; A100/v4 pool limited in ap-southeast1.
- Contingency pool target: 8% of total committed GPUs (hot standby) + 5% burst credits allocated per region.
- Overcommit policy: 1.08x on non-critical low-latency tiers; critical SLAs (enterprise gold) are strictly 1.00x.

Key assumptions and formulas used (for reviewers):
- Committed GPUs = contractual GPUs reserved (raw units).
- Allocated GPUs = committed * regional-allocation-slice for month.
- Projected monthly GPU-hours = Allocated GPUs * 720 (hours/month) * projected utilization (as a decimal).
- Buffer pool reservation = ceil(total_committed * 0.08).

Per-contract slices (selected customers — anonymized names):

1) FinNova (Contract FN-2026-07) — enterprise-gold
- Committed: 120 H100 GPUs (named contract)
- Regions requested: us-west1 (primary) 80 GPUs, eu-west1 (failover) 40 GPUs
- Start: 2026-10-01; Term: 24 months
- Ramp plan (monthly allocated GPUs):
  Sep-2026: 0 (preparation)
  Oct-2026: 40
  Nov-2026: 80
  Dec-2026: 110
  Jan-2027: 120
  Feb-2027: 120
- Projected utilization: Oct 40%, Nov 60%, Dec 72%, Jan+Feb 78%
- Notes: Requires private peering in us-west1 by 2026-09-20 (INFRA-3421). No overcommit allowed.

2) HealthGrid (Contract HG-2026-03) — enterprise-standard
- Committed: 48 A100/v4 GPUs
- Regions: eu-west1 28, ap-southeast1 20
- Start: 2026-09-15 (already partially live)
- Ramp plan:
  Sep-2026: 20 (eu:12 / ap:8)
  Oct-2026: 28
  Nov-2026: 36
  Dec-2026: 44
  Jan-2027: 48
  Feb-2027: 48
- Projected utilization: steady 62% (workload regularized).
- Notes: ap-southeast1 has known capacity contention; plan to schedule non-latency jobs in eu-west1 when possible. Burstable credits: 4 GPUs for Dec+Jan.

3) Acme Apps (Contract AA-2026-08) — startup reserved pool
- Committed: 16 A100/v4 GPUs (monthly reserved)
- Regions: us-west1 10, eu-west1 6
- Ramp plan: flat allocation from Oct onward (16)
- Projected utilization: 35–45% (sporadic spikes).
- Overcommit allowed: 1.1x for Oct–Dec (startup promo), re-evaluate by 2027-01.
- Notes: Eligible for burst credits from contingency pool; SLA is bronze (no strict latency SLO).

Aggregate summary (regional view, snapshot Sep-2026 planning):
- Total committed (all contracts above + pipeline provisional): 204 GPUs (H100/A100 mix).
- Region allocation targets (initial): us-west1 120 (59%), eu-west1 74 (36%), ap-southeast1 10 (5%).
- Buffer pool (8% target): 17 GPUs (round up to 18 across regions to keep whole units).
- Burst credit pool: 10 GPU-months reserved for Q4 marketing promos.

Allocation timeline matrix (example — allocated GPUs per month, combined view):
Columns: Sep-26 | Oct-26 | Nov-26 | Dec-26 | Jan-27 | Feb-27
Row: FinNova: 0 | 40 | 80 | 110 | 120 | 120
Row: HealthGrid: 20 | 28 | 36 | 44 | 48 | 48
Row: AcmeApps: 0 | 16 | 16 | 16 | 16 | 16
Row: Contingency Pool: 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18
Row: Total Allocated: 38 | 102 | 150 | 188 | 202 | 202

Capacity constraints & risk indicators:
- Risk R1 (High): H100 supply shortfall in us-west1 if FinNova misses peering deadline — could push 30 GPUs to eu-west1 triggering latency regressions. Mitigation: region failover test 2026-09-28 (owner: Mateo).
- Risk R2 (Medium): ap-southeast1 A100 contention due to vendor maintenance windows in Oct/Nov. Mitigation: schedule batch jobs to eu-west1 and pre-warm KV caches.
- Risk R3 (Low): Overcommit exhaustion if seasonal spikes occur in Dec — maintain burst credits and throttle non-critical tenants.

Operational actions (next 30 days):
- Infra network: complete private peering for FinNova in us-west1 (INFRA-3421) — owner: Maya — due 2026-09-20.
- Capacity ops: reserve additional 12 H100 units in eu-west1 as contingency hold (temporary) — owner: Priya — due 2026-09-22.
- Billing/Finance: confirm invoicing cadence for ramp months with Finance (FN-2026-07 ramp clause) — owner: Noah — open JIRA FIN-121.
- SRE: run failover simulation from us-west1 to eu-west1 with FinNova synthetic traffic — owner: Sophie — scheduled 2026-09-28.
- Product: finalize A/B routing policy for overcommit fallback (policy doc link in Confluence) — owner: product-hosted-api team — due 2026-09-25.

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Q1: Do we convert the 8% buffer into hard-per-region reservations or keep it as a regional shared pool? (Ops prefers regional share; Sales requests hard reservations for some enterprise accounts).
- Q2: Approve temporary eu-west1 H100 buy (12 units) at spot-lot price (estimated capex). Approval from finance required by 2026-09-21.
- Q3: Re-evaluate overcommit policy for startup-tier customers after Dec-2026 if utilization stays >70% for 2 consecutive months.

Historical notes and provenance:
- Derived from: contract documents (CS provided attachments), Sales ramp emails, and recent capacity scan snapshot taken 2026-08-31 (infra-capacity-scan-2026-08-31.csv).
- This sheet replaces the previous draft titled ‘reservation-runway-customer-gpu-sprint-2026-07’ for the specific per-contract phasing exercise. Keep both for audit.

Appendix (quick formulas and checks):
- Quick capacity sanity check: Total Allocated (Dec-26) 188 + pipeline margin (10) + buffer 18 = 216 => must be <= physical capacity per region; if > capacity, auto-flag a redistribution.
- Utilization check: If any contract projection shows month util > 85% consistently, trigger capacity review and potential immediate procurement.

Confluence reference: Capacity Playbook (linked in metadata).
